label: IN_ACT_FORMALLY_1: A cause is IN_ACT_FORMALLY_1 in a perfection when it has that perfection in the…
definition: A cause is in act formally in a perfection when it has that perfection in the same form in which it produces it, as fire that is hot makes the wood hot.
note: Lean: a primitive parameter of the sense-fork frame (its own declaration, distinct from the other senses of its disambiguation); it carries no definitional body.
